verdict.rationale: Replicate is a model-hosting API provider, so first-party integration guides for coding agents and agent frameworks are a fair question. The evidence pack only shows an llms.txt file and generic get-started guides for Node.js and Colab. These are developer building blocks and language quickstarts, not documented guides for plugging Replicate into coding agents or agent frameworks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the provider into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, first-party integration guides
